spec: SPEC-02 — CUSTOMER WALLET, BILLING & TOPUP TRUTH
invariants_enforced: FORBIDDEN: fake zero, localStorage balance, optimistic credit, UI approved before ledger, fake receipt, HTTP 200 interpreted as money success

defect_remediation.summary: Displayed wallet balance and ledger truth discrepancy
defect_remediation.reproduction: Web called /api/v1/wallet which dispatched to /internal/v1/wallet on Bot port 8080. Bot did not expose read endpoints for /internal/v1/wallet -> returned 404 -> Web App returned CORE_BRIDGE_NOT_CONFIGURED. Portal.js fell back to hardcoded { balance_xu: 100 }.
remediation: Added direct read-through projection in copyfast_api.py against shared canonical SQLite database (/data/toandaas_system.db) querying users.credits and credit_events ledger.
Explicitly distinguished unlinked accounts: returns ok=False, status_name='unlinked', error_code='ACCOUNT_TELEGRAM_UNLINKED' (never fake 0).
Explicitly distinguished database failure: returns ok=False, status_name='guarded', error_code='WALLET_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE' (never fake 0).
Catalog endpoints /api/v1/pricing and /api/v1/packages provide canonical catalog fallback when bridge is unavailable, without requiring linked Telegram identity.
Preserved canonical @router.get('/payments/{payment_id}') payment_status read projection without altering the 724 route contract.
Aligned db.py schema: users.total_spent and payos_orders.payment_type + package_id columns.
Purged hardcoded mock { balance_xu: 100 } fallbacks from static/portal/portal.js (headerWallet, renderMembership, accountWallet, executeCopilotQuery).

tests.name: test_first_red_displayed_wallet_balance_and_ledger_truth
tests.verifies: Canonical wallet balance matching users.credits, ledger reconciliation with credit_events, refresh behavior

tests.name: test_unlinked_account_does_not_return_fake_zero
tests.verifies: Unlinked accounts return ACCOUNT_TELEGRAM_UNLINKED and status_name='unlinked', not fake 0

tests.name: test_database_unavailable_does_not_return_fake_zero
tests.verifies: Database disconnection returns WALLET_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE and status_name='guarded', not fake 0

tests.name: test_pricing_and_packages_availability
tests.verifies: Pricing and packages endpoints return canonical data without bridge failure or auth linkage error

tests.name: test_manual_topup_idempotency_and_no_optimistic_credit
tests.verifies: Idempotent replay returns same ticket without duplicate ledger mutation; conflicting key yields 409; pending state does not credit balance optimistically

tests.name: test_wallet_refresh_reconciles_ledger_and_balance
tests.verifies: Subsequent credit event updates canonical balance and appears in history

tests.name: test_payos_order_validation_and_status
tests.verifies: PayOS checkout creates valid order record with canonical schema and /status alias works

tests.name: test_no_hardcoded_fake_balances_in_portal_js
tests.verifies: Zero occurrences of fake mock balance 100 in portal.js runtime
